# ScorX - Player Development Analytics for Grassroots Sports

## About
ScorX is an Australian-developed iOS player development analytics platform that transforms game statistics into AI-powered training plans. It provides athleticism benchmarking, performance tracking, and development insights across 16 sports including AFL, basketball, netball, rugby union, rugby league, touch rugby, soccer, field hockey, volleyball, water polo, tennis, badminton, squash, racquetball, pickleball, and table tennis.

## Key Facts
- AI-powered training recommendations identify skill development priorities from game statistics
- Athleticism benchmarking with age and gender-specific comparisons
- Player development tracking across seasons with historical performance trends
- Tracks 100+ customisable statistical activities across 16 sports
- Works completely offline - full functionality without internet connection
- iCloud sync for family sharing across devices
- CSV export for data analysis and record-keeping
- PDF export with custom templates (Coach tier)
- Team Triage Dashboard for coaches (Coach tier)
- AI Team Training Plans (Coach tier)
- Professional Player Cards with custom designs
- 30-day free trial, no credit card required
- Setup takes less than 2 minutes
- Real-time statistics updated during live games
- Privacy-first approach - no ads, no tracking, no third-party data sharing
- Sport-specific scoring rules for all 16 supported sports

## Pricing
- **Free Tier**: $0/month - 20 Games per month, All 16 sports, Comprehensive statistics, Offline mode, 30-day game history
- **Family Tier**: $4.99/month or $49.99/year - AI Training Recommendations, Athleticism Benchmarking, Up to 5 Players, 50 Games per month, iCloud Sync, CSV Export, 2-Year history, Family Sharing (5 members)
- **Coach Tier**: $9.99/month or $99.99/year - Everything in Family plus Team Triage Dashboard, AI Team Training Plans, 5 Teams, 150 Players, 100 Games per month, Advanced Analytics (perception vs reality), Professional Player Cards, PDF & CSV Export, Multi-Team Management

## Use Cases
- **For Junior Athletes**: Monitor personal performance with AI-generated training priorities based on actual game data. Track skill development across seasons. Understand exactly what to work on to reach the next level.
- **For Parents**: Understand how your children are developing as athletes—not just scores, but actual skill progression and physical development. Build comprehensive performance histories they'll treasure.
- **For Grassroots Coaches**: Access professional-grade analytics for community programs. Identify team-wide development priorities. Make informed training decisions based on actual performance gaps, not guesswork.
- **For Clubs and Academies**: Centralised player development tracking across entire rosters. Identify systematic training needs. Balance technical, tactical, and athletic development priorities with evidence-based insights.

## Core Features
- **AI Training Intelligence**: Analyses match performance to identify skill development priorities and training focus areas. Recommendations update every 30 days or after 5 games.
- **Athleticism Benchmarking**: Track sprint times, jump height, endurance against age/gender-specific benchmarks. Identify whether development priorities are technical, tactical, or athletic.
- **Performance Tracking**: Complete game histories, searchable archives, historical performance trends, development trajectories across seasons.
- **Live Game Scoring**: Sport-specific scoring rules, configurable timers, full offline functionality.
- **Team Development Dashboard**: Team Triage, aggregated player assessments, AI team training plans (Coach tier).

## Technical Details
- Platform: iOS 18.0 or later
- Offline capability: Full functionality without internet
- Data portability: CSV export of all statistics; PDF export on Coach tier
- Family Sharing: Supported on Family and Coach tiers through iCloud
- Data retention: 2-year history on Family tier
- Privacy: No third-party data sharing, no advertisements, no analytics tracking
- App size: 11.5 MB
